name: M3_OIS120MI_GetCOStopInfo
description: Retrieve customer order stop and credit information for a single customer order. The operation exposes header-level data such as customer and payer, order status and dates, stop and block indicators, and detailed credit-check figures including the three main credit limits, corresponding outstanding amounts, and remaining headroom. The information mirrors what is shown in the customer order stop inquiry and is based on the order header, customer/payer, order type, facility, and credit control settings.

inputParameters.name: ORNO
inputParameters.description: Customer order number identifying the order for which stop information is retrieved.

outputParameters.name: PYNO
outputParameters.description: Number identifying the payer responsible for the invoices on the order.

outputParameters.name: CUNO
outputParameters.description: Number identifying the customer who placed the order.

outputParameters.name: BLCD
outputParameters.description: Block code controlling whether customer order entry and picking list printing are blocked for the customer.

outputParameters.name: SMCD
outputParameters.description: Salesperson responsible for the customer or this order.

outputParameters.name: ORNO
outputParameters.description: Customer order number identifying the order for which stop information is retrieved.

outputParameters.name: ORTP
outputParameters.description: Customer order type that controls number series and processing rules for the order.

outputParameters.name: ORSL
outputParameters.description: Lowest line status among all lines on the customer order.

outputParameters.name: ORST
outputParameters.description: Highest line status among all lines on the customer order.

outputParameters.name: ORDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the customer order was registered.

outputParameters.name: RLDT
outputParameters.description: Date requested by the customer for delivery of the order.

outputParameters.name: NTAM
outputParameters.description: Net order value including discounts, expressed in the domestic currency and excluding charges.

outputParameters.name: OBLC
outputParameters.description: Stop code used to filter the list to customer orders blocked for a specific reason.
outputParameters.enumConstants: No stop - picking list can be printed,Credit limit 1 (overdue),Credit limit 2 (total outstanding),Credit limit 3 (outstanding + order stock),Credit limit 4 (number of days overdue),Connected to letter of credit via (RMS100),Time fenced credit limit issue,Manually set stop for optional use,Manually set stop for optional use,Manually released order

outputParameters.name: STAT
outputParameters.description: Status of the customer order stop record.

outputParameters.name: LNCD
outputParameters.description: Language code used for printing external documents for this order.

outputParameters.name: TEPY
outputParameters.description: Payment terms defining how the invoice due date for this order is calculated.

outputParameters.name: CUCD
outputParameters.description: Currency code used for the credit limits and monetary amounts shown for this payer.

outputParameters.name: CRLM
outputParameters.description: Credit limit for past due invoices used when checking the payer's credit.

outputParameters.name: ODIN
outputParameters.description: Total invoice amount that is overdue for payment, excluding VAT, in the customer's currency.

outputParameters.name: DIF1
outputParameters.description: Available credit for past due invoices, calculated as credit limit 1 minus the overdue invoice amount.

outputParameters.name: CRL2
outputParameters.description: Credit limit for total outstanding invoices used when checking the payer's credit.

outputParameters.name: OINA
outputParameters.description: Total outstanding invoice amount, excluding VAT, in the customer's currency.

outputParameters.name: DIF2
outputParameters.description: Available credit for outstanding invoices, calculated as credit limit 2 minus the outstanding invoice amount.

outputParameters.name: CRL3
outputParameters.description: Credit limit for combined outstanding invoices and open orders used when checking the payer's credit.

outputParameters.name: OVNI
outputParameters.description: Total order value not yet invoiced, expressed in the customer's currency.

outputParameters.name: OWOR
outputParameters.description: Outstanding invoice amount considered without credit risk and excluded when evaluating credit limits.

outputParameters.name: OVWR
outputParameters.description: Order value considered without credit risk and excluded when evaluating credit limit 3.

outputParameters.name: DIF3
outputParameters.description: Available credit for invoices and orders combined, calculated as credit limit 3 minus the order value not yet invoiced.

outputParameters.name: PYGR
outputParameters.description: Credit group used for joint credit checking and credit limits across associated payers.
